compatibility.reason: The frontend requires the native window registry, per-window lock ownership, mobile startup handoff and coordinated Android modal Back handling.

ios-store.en-US: Open workspaces in multiple iPad windows, use the reorganized settings, and start with a new launch screen.
ios-store.zh-Hans: 支持在 iPad 上通过多个窗口打开工作空间，重新组织设置，并更新启动界面。

android-play.zh-CN: 更新启动界面和设置布局，改进返回操作，保护尚未保存的设置。

macos-direct.zh-Hans: 更新窗口控件和设置，改进工作空间窗口管理与同步。

apple.reason: iPad multi-window, native startup and reorganized settings introduce new app behavior.
